{
  "phoneNote": "The hero works well with the arched salon photos, but the services and prices are split into two separate sections and the contact block repeats the footer.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero composition is strong and editorial, though the top navigation is nearly empty and the bottom of the page repeats the contact details and hours.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Merge the 'Cene, ki jih poznate vnaprej' and 'Kaj vam lahko uredimo' sections into a single unified service and price list so visitors don't read the same services twice.",
    "Remove the duplicate address, email, and opening hours from the footer since they are already featured in dedicated sections right above it.",
    "Loosen the letter-spacing on the display headings slightly so words like 'Frizerski salon Mia' and 'poznate vnaprej' do not run together."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop, the 'Pokličite za termin' contact section and the 'Kdaj nas obiščete' hours section are immediately repeated inside the dark footer."
  ]
}
